user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Cozy Log Cabin Interior. The inside of a small log cabin on a winter night: stacked timber walls, a stone fireplace with a flickering fire and glowing embers, a worn leather armchair with a knitted throw, a bookshelf, a bearskin-style rug, and a steaming mug on a side table. A frosted window shows snow drifting outside, an oil lamp glows on the desk, and firelight dances across the beamed ceiling. Style: warm stylized realism. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
